svg.title: Highlights
svg.desc: DevOps at HP Inc: 3.5 years (intern from March 2022, then engineer from August 2022 to December 2025), AWS, Terraform and on-call for device telemetry. Data platform: petabyte-scale telemetry from millions of devices into a five-tier lake, Kinesis to S3 to Redshift. GDPR erasure: cut from up to a month to 48 hours by replacing a manual process with Airflow automation. Available for a co-op from January to August 2027 in DevOps, cloud, SRE or AI/ML.
